def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    marker=min(set(v for row in grid for v in row))
    # The sparse non-background color marks vertices; fill its convex hull.
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row))
    pts=sorted({(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg})
    if len(pts)<3:return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # monotone-chain hull in (x=col,y=row)
    p=sorted((c,r) for r,c in pts)
    def cross(o,a,b): return (a[0]-o[0])*(b[1]-o[1])-(a[1]-o[1])*(b[0]-o[0])
    lo=[]
    for x in p:
        while len(lo)>=2 and cross(lo[-2],lo[-1],x)<=0:lo.pop()
        lo.append(x)
    up=[]
    for x in reversed(p):
        while len(up)>=2 and cross(up[-2],up[-1],x)<=0:up.pop()
        up.append(x)
    hull=lo[:-1]+up[:-1]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]==bg: # point is within/on convex polygon
          inside=True
          for i,a in enumerate(hull):
            b=hull[(i+1)%len(hull)]
            if cross(a,b,(c,r))<0: inside=False;break
          if inside:out[r][c]=3
    return out
PY
